patch_description: Apply the co-sweep recommendation as an atomic parameter change to Stage 5: lower k (0.6 → 0.45) so the hysteresis snap catches more sub-noise steps, and raise blend (0.6 → 0.75) so snapped steps are pulled more completely toward the local median. False reversals are the strongest rank predictor (21.2 → 0.64 score), so lowering the threshold is the highest-leverage move, while the higher blend compensates by removing those caught steps more thoroughly. The sign-hysteresis mask logic stays byte-identical — only the permissiveness/completeness balance changes, consistent with the evidence that adding new damping mechanisms fails but tuning this validated one is untested.
